note: Georgia under Mongol tribute through Ilkhanate (note: Ilkhanate not Golden Horde — using closest available).

_quarry.structural_significance: Georgia's incorporation as a Mongol vassal under the Ilkhanate paradoxically preserved its political existence while enabling continued Orthodox patronage; the Mongol Pax allowed Georgian merchants access to the Eurasian trade network while the Mongol buffer temporarily reduced Ottoman-Mamluk pressure, demonstrating how tributary submission could be a survival strategy rather than mere subjugation.
